segments.en:
King Foizon of the Kingdom of Lau
wishes to form an alliance.
Head for the town of Tatara.

rows.notes: Tatara (Lau's capital) romanized; not in the glossary.

segments.en:
Drake Luft of the Kingdom of A
wishes to form an alliance.
Head for Laas Wau.

rows.notes: Laas Wau as in the library draft (Drake profile); not in the glossary.

segments.en: You are most welcome here!

Let us fight together to
strike down Drake's army!!

An alliance with the Kingdom of Lau
has been formed.

Drake Luft's power keeps
growing ever greater.

I want you to go to the Kingdom of Na
and negotiate with Ciela Lapana.

Once we have an alliance with Na,
we go on the counteroffensive!
Understood.

Could someone be assigned
to guide us?

That duty has been entrusted
to my Zelerna Unit.
This is Sir Nie Given.

His unit is small, but it has
a fine Holy Warrior in its ranks.

That's a big help.
We're counting on you.
Well, let us be off.

Even as we speak, Drake's army
keeps growing stronger.
Right!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Zelerna Unit' to match the glossary's 'Botune (Zelerna Unit)'.

segments.en: I'm Sho Zama.
Looking forward to working with you.
Nice to meet you.
So you're all from the Zelerna Unit.
I'm Kanji Akatsuki.

I'm more or less the combat leader,
so I'll be the one commanding you.
Well, let's take it easy.

If anything's wrong,
tell me right away, okay?
He doesn't seem very reliable~
I can see why...
Ha ha ha...

People usually think that about
Kanji at first, you know.
Then again, he really is unreliable.
Ouch...

Well, in my case, I guess it's all
thanks to the friends backing me up?

Nothing wrong with that, is there?
That kind of leader works too.

It's not like any of us
are raw recruits, after all.
Heh... I suppose so.
Then that settles it!
The Zelerna Unit has joined you.
Hm?
That alarm...
Drake's army has appeared!

Damn it!
At a time like this!

Lau's entire army will move
to intercept them!

His Majesty asks that you set out
and make for the Kingdom of Na!
We're running without a fight?

Wait!
I'm checking the data right now.

Okay!
The enemy data's up!
I see...

The enemy force isn't
all that big...
It's probably a reconnaissance in force.

Looks like it'd be quicker to just
drive them off right here.

But King Foizon has made
his decision, hasn't he?
He'll understand.

King Foizon needs to see
what Kanji and the others
can do, too, right?
I suppose so...

Chum! Go tell Nie
and King Foizon!

Got it!
I'm off!
All ships, prepare for battle!

Beginning final check
of all weapons!

rows.notes: [25] 'His Majesty asks' restores the implied source of the order (Foizon, confirmed by [33]). [15] Sho approves Kanji's style of leading. | [accuracy 12] 'he really isn't' read as the opposite after Lun's line; Nelfea is confirming Kanji IS unreliable (hence his 'Ouch') | [editorial 15] literal 'Isn't that fine? / That kind of leader, I mean' read stiff; Sho casually approving Kanji's style | [editorial 31] line break split the term 'reconnaissance in force'

segments.en:
So that's the ship the Redros Army
tipped us off about.

But our forces aren't enough
to take Tatara, sir...
I know that.

Just strike once and
gauge their strength!
As you command!
All units, get ready to launch!
Roger!

Remaining enemy ships
are falling back!

Phew...
It's over...
All units, return to the ship!
Roger!
Kanji, you guys are amazing!
That was quite something...
I'm kind of... a little scared...

Huh?
What's wrong?
Well...

It feels like... this war is
going to get really, really big.
Maybe so...
A splendid fight.

Thanks to you, everyone's
morale is running high.
I thank you for your valor!

Not at all. We only did
what we had to.

Now then, I'll finally take you
to the Kingdom of Na.

Oh, yes.
We're in your hands.

On the way, we'll join up
with reinforcements.
They're at Mt. Karakara.
Displaying the marker.

You'll go by way of Mt. Karakara
before heading to the Kingdom of Na.

rows.notes: [7] source [jp] read as [jp] (typo). Mt. Karakara romanized; not in the glossary. | [editorial 21] 'pass by' suggests not stopping; [jp] = via (they join reinforcements there)

segments.en:
Whoa, I can see one
seriously huge ship.
That's the Goraon.

Lady Elle has come out
to meet us.
Guide beacon confirmed!
Prepare to come alongside!
Roger.
Goraon: Bridge

I am Elle Hunm, daughter of
Pinegan Hunm, King of the Kingdom of Mi.

With all my heart, I welcome all of you
who have come to lend us your strength.

Lady Elle is King Foizon's
granddaughter.

She is prepared to become heir
to the Kingdom of Lau.
Then the Kingdom of Mi...?

The Kingdom of Mi...
has fallen...

But King Foizon entrusted
the Goraon to me.

To repay his kindness, I must
guide this world in a better
direction.

To end this evil war, and make
Byston Well a world without
borders between nations.
Joined up with the Goraon.

rows.notes: [1] source writes [jp]; rendered Pinegan Hunm as in the library ([jp], Elle's profile) -- likely a source typo. | [editorial 2] 'From my heart, I welcome' unidiomatic | [proofread 0] location card in the UI 'Place: Room' form (style sheet; cf. 'Balket: Bridge')

segments.en: So it's finally the Kingdom of Na.
Yeah...

Even inside Na, recon units from
Drake's army and the Redros Army
are flying about.

Please don't neglect
your preparations.
Understood.

Launch for Uroporos,
capital of the Kingdom of Na!

Sho! Marvel!
Don't slack on anti-air watch!
I know!

rows.notes: [jp] romanized Uroporos (not Ouroboros: source has [jp]); not in the glossary.

segments.en: We're almost at Uroporos.

I can see a city up ahead.
Is that it?
Yes...

But...
something is wrong.
Detected an approaching fleet.

Oh!
Did they come out to meet us again?

What?
That's not Lady Ciela's ship...!
That's the enemy!

Whaaat?!
Why is the enemy in Uroporos?!
Transmission from the enemy ship!

Heh... Did you think you could
just waltz in and join up?
Sho!!
Todd!
Looks like they got here first...

I can see right through anything
you people would come up with!

This time, I'm settling
things for good!
Oh, no...!

Hey, what about Lady Ciela?!
What's happened to Lady Ciela?
She's all right.

I can sense Lady Ciela's
Aura Power coming from
somewhere else.

Everyone!
For now, focus on the enemy
in front of you!
Understood!

All right!
Let's go, everyone!!

rows.notes: [5] source [jp] is a typo for [jp]: rendered Todd. | [editorial 12] term: aura power is lowercase (project decision)

segments.en:
Holy Warrior!!
Our losses are too heavy!
We can't hold out much longer!!
Tch!

I got too far from the main force...
I can't expect any more reinforcements...
Right, we're pulling out!!
Roger!

This isn't over!
Sho!!
Enemy fleet repelled.
No enemy contacts in the area.

Sho!
Can we get into the city?
Yeah!

Doesn't look like there are
any enemies hiding there.
No word from Lady Ciela?

No...
Not so far...

In any case,
let's dock.

rows.notes: [accuracy 3] verb and subject restored ([jp]); 'No hope of...' had neither | [editorial 3] literal '/' in the text instead of a line break

segments.en: Nie, what now?

Let's go into the city anyway.
Someone may still be there.
Then let's go.

Sir Nie!
You're safe!

What happened?
Where's Lady Ciela?!

Lady Ciela moved the entire fleet
so the city wouldn't be engulfed
in the fighting.

We're under radio silence now,
so we can't reach them by radio...

I see...
So Lady Ciela is safe.

Then all we have to do is join
up with the fleet directly.
Yes.

Your guide should be arriving
at your ship about now.

Right, let's get ready to depart.
Back to the ship!

Hm?
This machine...

A Brain Powerd...
It's my partner.
Are you our guide?
I'm Yu Isami.

I'll take you to Lady Ciela's
flagship, the Gran-Garan.
You're Japanese?

Are you a Holy Warrior,
like Sho?

Hmm...
Not quite?

We did come from another world,
that's for sure.

But we don't ride
Aura Battlers.
And you are?
Hime Utsumiya.

Like Yu, I'm a
Brain Powerd pilot.

I see...
Good to have you.

When you set out, take
a battleship that can fly.

Lady Ciela's Gran-Garan isn't on land.
It's above the Sea of Clouds.
I see. Got it!

The Brain Powerd Team
has joined the unit.

rows.notes: [7] source [jp] read as [jp]. [16] Hime answers Kanji's question to You (speaker header Hime). [20] reading ([jp]) after the name dropped. [jp] -> 'Brain Powerd Team'. | [accuracy 10] verb restored in the answer to Kanji's 'This machine...' | [editorial 10] literal '/' in the text instead of a line break | [editorial 26] system line aligned to '<name> has joined the unit.'

segments.en: We've set out!

We'll now head for Lady Ciela's
flagship, the Gran-Garan!

We've reached our destination.
Take us in to dock!

rows.notes: [jp] may be a prompt to the player; rendered as Rie's order to the helm.

segments.en:
Lady Ciela, I'm so glad
to see you well.
And you, Elle.
Welcome to you all as well.

Let us join hands and
stand against Drake.
Yes, Lady Ciela.
An evil power is growing.

If this continues, it will
in time swallow every world.
Do you mean Drake?
That is part of it.

But behind Drake lies an even
greater source of power.

You must cut off the source
of this evil power.

(An evil power
 behind Drake...?)

(The Redros Army has to be
 mixed up in this...)
An alarm?!
What is it?!

Word has come that a great fleet of
Drake's army is heading for Tatara,
capital of the Kingdom of Lau!
What?!

I sense a strong Aura Power
nearing Lau.

At this rate, King Foizon
is in danger!

We, too, must commit
all our strength.

Organize reinforcements
at once!

This battle will be
the decisive one.
Everyone, steel yourselves.

rows.notes: [editorial 15] 'Drake Army' -> 'Drake's army' as everywhere else in the unit | [editorial 17] term: aura power is lowercase (project decision)

segments.en: We've set out.

Holding course for our
destination, Tatara!

Sho Zama, it seems you are making
good use of the Billbine I gave you.
Yes, it's a fine machine.
I see.
But do not forget.

Holding great power means you must
resist the temptation of evil power
all the more.
Yes, I understand...

I am counting on you,
Sho Zama.
Now, go.

King Foizon!
We've come to reinforce you!
I'm in your debt!
Drake's army is almost upon us.
Make your preparations at once.
Joined up with King Foizon's forces.

Setting out will lead to a battle
with Drake's fleet.
The battle will now begin.
Drake's army has been repelled.

The enemy forces in Byston Well
have been wiped out.
Lady Ciela...

Is using force to cut off
the evil power truly right?
I cannot help but see it...

Dark shadows spreading over
those with good hearts...
I feel it too.
Using force to hold back force...

That is what we are
trying to do.

And that can also help
the evil power grow.
Yes...

That is why we must
be resolved.

To purify the world once
it is all over...
Lady Ciela...

Elle, will you lend me
your strength?
Yes.

If it will save the world, I will
gladly offer up my life.
Thank you.

rows.notes: [14] [jp] rendered 'offer up my life' (lit. 'offer this body/myself'). | [editorial 2] [jp]: involuntary seeing (accuracy flag); links to the vision on the next page

segments.en: Welcome.

My army swears to faithfully uphold
the alliance forged between us
and your forces.

Formed an alliance with
Drake's army.

Our target is Tatara,
capital of the Kingdom of Lau.

Destroy the enemy's giant
battleship, the Goraon.

Enemy forces successfully
eliminated.
You can now dock at Tatara.

The conquest of Byston Well
is complete.
Head for another continent.
